login.title: Add free model keys (optional)
steps: Make a free Gemini key at aistudio.google.com/apikey and a free Groq key at console.groq.com/keys.
Paste each key in Settings > System > Free models. Neesmo keeps them only on this machine.
Skip this and Neesmo uses Claude for everything (works fine, costs a bit more of your Claude plan).

login.title: Connect GitHub
steps: Make a free account at github.com if you don't have one.
Press Connect. Neesmo shows a short code: open github.com/login/device, type the code, and allow.
Neesmo makes one private repository per channel, so nothing is ever lost.

login.title: Connect YouTube
steps: Open console.cloud.google.com, make a project (free), and turn on 'YouTube Data API v3' and 'YouTube Analytics API'.
Under 'Google Auth Platform', set the app to External, add yourself as a test user, then make an OAuth client of type 'Desktop app' and download its JSON.
Upload that JSON here, press Connect, and allow access with the Google account that owns the channel.

login.title: Connect Instagram
steps: In the Instagram app: Settings > Account type > switch to a free Professional (Creator) account.
Make a free app at developers.facebook.com (type 'Business'), add 'Instagram' with 'Instagram API with Instagram Login'.
Generate a token for your account there and paste it here with your app id. Neesmo checks it and keeps it only on this machine.
